sql: select not exists (select 1 from brandbase.posts p where p.brand_id = :brand and :channel = 'ig' and p.id <> :brand || '-' || :channel || '-' || :externalId and brandbase.ig_shortcode(p.permalink) = brandbase.ig_shortcode(:permalink)) as ok
message: this post is already in Brand Base under another id, from the account's read-back or a send
